title: Correlation
author: 696637e49d26457b33c7eff3
chapter_outcomes: Understand the difference between an independent and a dependent variable.

Understand and use the terms: positive correlation, negative correlation, weak correlation, strong correlation, no correlation. Including identifying correlation between variables given in a scatter diagram or table.
Plot bivariate data to form a scatter diagram.
Draw a line of best fit on a scatter diagram, by eye and by using the method of semi-averages. For the method of semi-averages, there will be an even number of data pairs.
Find the equation of a line of best fit. Equation expressed in the form y = mx + c.
Use a line of best fit to estimate the value of one variable, given the value of the other. From the graph of the line or its equation.
Understand the assumptions made when using a line of best fit for estimation. Including the limitations of extrapolation.
